c.v: module can be reset by the following bits:
: set this bit to reset LCD control unit (LCD_Ctrl) and LCD video data format converter (RGB/YCbCr Converter).
: set this bit to reset camera control unit (Camera_Ctrl) and camera video data format converter (RGB/YCbCr Converter).
: set this bit to reset Async Tx FIFO.
: set this bit to reset Async Rx FIFO.
The above-mentioned reset bits are hardware self-clearing, i.e., the hardware automatically clears these bits once 1 is written.
LCD/camera module clock must be configured first before the module and FIFO are reset.
